chunks.title: ITC Immunity Therapy Center — Alternative Cancer Treatment
chunks.text: ITC is in Tijuana, Mexico, minutes across the U.S. border, and was founded by Dr. Carlos Bautista.

chunks.title: ITC Immunity Therapy Center — Alternative Cancer Treatment
chunks.text: The approach begins with medical-record review, then individual planning, treatment explanation, daily monitoring, follow-up support, and coordination with the patient's existing doctors.

chunks.title: ITC Immunity Therapy Center — Alternative Cancer Treatment
chunks.text: Eligibility depends on cancer type, stage, organ function, previous treatment, medical history, and physical strength; qualified physicians review records before acceptance.

chunks.title: ITC Immunity Therapy Center — Alternative Cancer Treatment
chunks.text: The base standard multi-week program starts at $18,995 USD; total cost varies with duration, therapies, and diagnostic needs.

chunks.title: ITC Immunity Therapy Center — Alternative Cancer Treatment
chunks.text: Standard inclusions listed on the profile include physician consultations and daily care, a customized therapy suite, daily IV nutrition and natural supplements, monitoring and nursing care, local transportation assistance, and companion support.

chunks.title: ITC Immunity Therapy Center — Alternative Cancer Treatment
chunks.text: The clinic is near San Diego International Airport and its page says dedicated shuttle services support border crossings and local transit.

chunks.title: ITC Immunity Therapy Center — Alternative Cancer Treatment
chunks.text: The page says outcomes vary and patients should discuss risks and combinations with qualified physicians and avoid delaying necessary standard treatment without consulting their oncologist.

chunks.title: Alternative Adenocarcinoma Cancer Treatment in Tijuana
chunks.text: The 3-week out-patient program is $18,995 USD and the 3-week in-patient program is $30,000 USD.

chunks.title: Alternative Adenocarcinoma Cancer Treatment in Tijuana
chunks.text: Out-patient includes weekly lab work, one prescribed X-ray, ultrasound, or CT scan, standard program therapies, two health-focused meals on treatment days, standard protocol medications, and one follow-up consultation after three months.

chunks.title: Alternative Adenocarcinoma Cancer Treatment in Tijuana
chunks.text: In-patient includes 24/7 medical supervision, private room and board, three meals daily, weekly diagnostics, one prescribed imaging study, program therapies, protocol medications, and a follow-up consultation after three months.

chunks.title: Alternative Adenocarcinoma Cancer Treatment in Tijuana
chunks.text: Optional procedures cost extra, including LAK cells at $2,600 USD and intratumoral immunotherapy at $6,200–$7,200 USD.

chunks.title: Alternative Adenocarcinoma Cancer Treatment in Tijuana
chunks.text: Specialty medications, external specialist consultations, surgery or biopsies, blood products, emergency services, additional imaging, and home programs are excluded or may cost extra.

chunks.title: Alternative Adenocarcinoma Cancer Treatment in Tijuana
chunks.text: The typical itinerary is evaluation and initiation in week 1, intensive therapy in week 2, and consolidation and home-care planning in week 3.

chunks.title: Alternative Adrenal Cancer Treatment in Tijuana
chunks.text: The program page describes personalized immune stimulation, diagnostic monitoring, nutritional support, and post-care.

chunks.title: Alternative Adrenal Cancer Treatment in Tijuana
chunks.text: Optional specialized procedures and contingency services are additional costs.
